name: nice-figures
description: Generate matplotlib figures in a soft-pastel, warm-earth, research-blog visual register — bold sans-serif display titles, scatter overlaid with smoothed trends and shaded confidence bands, signature rounded bars, minimal axes, and '↓better' badges. White background by default (conference-ready), with an opt-in warm cream blog background. Ships 16 chart archetypes and a dependency-light style helper.
